entries.message: Keep one extension sidebar open in each Space and switch assistants from the toolbar
Improve Claude and ChatGPT browser tools, sign-in, page reading and screenshots
Organize open tabs in named, colored folders that sync and move between saved and open tabs
Move tabs and whole folders through the sidebar with clearer placement and immediate access after mobile drops
Keep website styling extensions from changing other extensions’ sidebars
Support extensions such as SponsorBlock that use relative background-worker paths
